instruction: Save the current video frame as a JPG file named 'movie_frame.jpg' on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires capturing a video frame and saving it as JPG format with filename 'movie_frame.jpg' on Desktop. Evaluator verifies: (1) file exists at specified location, (2) file is valid JPG/JPEG format, (3) file size is reasonable (>5KB). This variation tests ability to work with different image formats.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: file existence, JPG format validation, and reasonable file size
Getter logic is sound: retrieves file from correct path, validates format using PIL (not just extension), returns all necessary information
Metric logic is correct: properly handles expected parameter (receives rules dict directly when type='rule'), checks all three requirements with appropriate scoring (50% exists, 30% format, 20% size)
Coverage is complete: all aspects of the instruction are verified (file location, JPG format, reasonable size for video frame)
Expected value is appropriate: min_size of 5000 bytes (5KB) is reasonable for a captured video frame
No state timing issues: file operations don't require postconfig as file is persisted to disk
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0.0 if file doesn't exist, preventing false positives
